what: No official boundary map exists in the archive. Divisions are built from census enumeration districts (a public ArcGIS layer whose publisher is unverified), grouped by the PEO’s village table. 7 divisions couldn’t be placed from their village names: B02, B10, C04, D06, H06, K02, K10.
action: Needs official polling-division boundary files (PEO or Lands and Surveys).
sources: PEO Electoral Constituencies and Polling Divisions Table (Jan 2018)
